concepts.gloss_en: Idolatry (avodah zarah); foreign/idol worship — the paradigm of corrupted faith and heresy

reason_for_human: Both surface forms are the identical phrase עבודה זרה — the only difference is spacing/maqaf formatting, not a homograph or a distinct word. Every one of the 11 occurrences uses it in the same sense of idolatry/foreign worship as the archetype of corrupted faith (even where the proof text swaps in the synonym עבודת אלילים, the vocalized/tagged form is עבודה זרה). Safe single-concept merge.
